svg.title: Building an entry with overlapping compression
svg.desc: A CSA entry reads eight tokens: four of the previous span (a) and four of its own span (b). Scores Z plus the per-span, per-offset bias B are softmaxed once across the eight tokens, weight the candidates C, are summed, then get RMSNorm and RoPE (position = the start of its own stride span). Neighbouring entries share half their span.

svg.text: Building an entry with overlapping compression
Previous span a + own span b, one softmax over 8 · m = 4

text.tspan: Real CSA value m = 4 · a regular entry reads 4 tokens of the previous span + 4 of its own (entry 0 only its own 4)
Orange column = one channel · upper half a = previous span (0–3), lower half b = its own span (4–7)
Z: score from token content · B
: learned bias per span and offset (added, then one softmax over 8)
Neighbouring entries share half their span (stride = 4)
